ideas.title: FBI's Election Integrity Investigations: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's role in ensuring election integrity, including the surge of 260 analysts in Fulton County, Georgia.
ideas.angle: Exploring the impact of the FBI's investigation on election integrity and potential implications for future elections.
questions: What are the findings of the FBI's investigation?
How will this impact future elections?
ideas.insight: The FBI's investigation into election records in Fulton County, Georgia, raises important questions about election integrity and the potential for fraud.

ideas.title: The Rise of Fraudulent Schemes in Minnesota
ideas.description: Examine the recent conclusion of a 'Shariah compliant' home scam case in Minnesota court and its implications for the state.
ideas.angle: Investigating the prevalence of fraudulent schemes in Minnesota and the efforts to combat them.
questions: What are the common types of fraudulent schemes in Minnesota?
How effective are law enforcement efforts to combat these schemes?
ideas.insight: The conclusion of a 'Shariah compliant' home scam case in Minnesota court highlights the ongoing issue of fraudulent schemes in the state.
